create_vector_store_new: create a new vector store via POST /vector_store/new with vector_store_id and custom_llm_provider
list_vector_stores: list all accessible vector stores with pagination via GET /vector_store/list
delete_vector_store: delete a vector store by ID via POST /vector_store/delete
get_vector_store_info: get details of a single vector store by ID via POST /vector_store/info
update_vector_store: update vector store details in database and in-memory registry via POST /vector_store/update
resolve_embedding_config: resolve embedding config from router or database for a given embedding model string
